description: This file defines the AccountSwitcherDialog class, a dialog fragment for switching and managing user accounts within the Android Nextcloud Notes app. It handles UI interactions, observes account data, and provides options to add or manage accounts.

classes.name: AccountSwitcherDialog
classes.description: A dialog fragment that displays available user accounts, allowing users to switch, add, or manage accounts within the app.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Initializes the dialog, ensuring the context implements the required listener and retrieves the current account ID from arguments.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and configures the dialog UI, sets up observers for account data, and handles user interactions for switching or managing accounts.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of the dialog with the specified current account ID.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies branding styles to the dialog based on the provided color.
